query.text: 购物助手，请陪我一起选购商品，在我询问价格、优惠或对比时给予解答。
query.text_en: Shopping assistant, please shop with me and answer my questions when I ask about prices, discounts, or comparisons.

annotation.text_zh: 请提供更多信息，我为你查阅。
annotation.text_en: Please provide more information, and I will look it up for you.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
